purpose: Defines the values to prioritize and the aims to avoid when writing or reviewing requirements and design documents, plus review severity routing.
summary: Structural design principles to prioritize: responsibility split, boundary definition, dependency direction
Document-level dependency direction across requirements, design, and plan documents
Quality attributes treated as outcomes, never as direct numeric targets (Goodhart's law)
Prohibited primary aims: quantifying structural quality, KPIs, fabricated unconfirmed numbers
Typical inverted patterns and self-check questions for judgment
Routing of quantitative targets to the spec/design boundary document
Perspective routing of this document for review perspectives P1, P2, and P3
Severity catalog mapping each norm violation to critical or major
Gray-zone tolerance table for numeric targets, TBD handling, and coverage goals
Non-functional requirement category coverage with severity scoping and exclusion rationale
tasks: Deciding whether to set numeric targets
Checking dependency direction between generated documents
title: 要件定義書・設計書で優先すること
